on: the half-leading round, B' (fix/half-leading-b2): a paragraph's first line keeps the original's first baseline; where the next line of its column, which keeps its own, stands nearer its last line than the larger of the two paragraphs' leadings and the original's own skip there (its room past its pitch, capped at a pitch, as paraGapTight reads it), the paragraph above ends higher by the deficit, its fill spread over a shorter height
english: approved B' for half-leading (starts never move; boundary target = the larger leading plus the original's own skip; the deficit comes from the paragraph above), 2026-10-17, relayed by the coordinator
measures: paragraph gaps a pitch or more wider
scope: Measured on fix/half-leading-b2's own model run against next (c77550a1), the 30 outputs: paragraph starts below the original's first baseline 0 of 1,217 in Chinese, Japanese and Korean (the line boxes, A, moved 677 of them, median 0.167 of a pitch, at most 0.328); 111 pages and 744 units moved, all on the CJK outputs, none of the alphabets. Gated rows worse per output (38): blank lines / frame 8 (zh 1512.03385 0.226 to 0.481, 1706.03762 0.212 to 0.389, 1810.04805 0.292 to 0.537, the thesis 0.545 to 0.591, 2608.04322 0.289 to 0.525, 2608.16117 0.43 to 0.499; ko 1706.03762 0.236 to 0.268, 2608.04322 0.253 to 0.297); paragraph gap / the original's 8 (zh 1512.03385 1.039 to 2.638, 1706.03762 1.021 to 1.839, 1810.04805 1.223 to 2.462, the thesis 1.4 to 1.89, 2608.04322 1 to 3.291, 2608.16117 1.021 to 1.881; ko 1706.03762 1.038 to 1.364, 2608.04322 1 to 1.28); fill 6 (zh 1512.03385 0.998 to 0.949, 1706.03762 0.998 to 0.903, 1810.04805 0.997 to 0.943, 2608.04322 0.998 to 0.937, 2608.16117 0.999 to 0.974; ko 1706.03762 0.999 to 0.972); frames with a blank line 6 (zh 1512.03385, 1810.04805, the thesis, 2608.04322, 2608.16117; ko 2608.04322 0.048 to 0.058); paragraph gaps a pitch or more wider 5 (zh 1512.03385, 1810.04805, the thesis, 2608.04322, 2608.16117); frames past the right edge 2 (zh 1810.04805 0.178 to 0.189, the thesis 0.245 to 0.256); pitch spread 2 (zh 2608.04322 0.268 to 0.301, 2608.16117 0.451 to 0.5); size spread 1 (the thesis 0 to 0.024). Pooled per target, as the rules gate reads them: ko blank lines, frames with a blank line and paragraph gap; zh fill, blank lines, frames with a blank line, paragraph gap and paragraph gaps wider. The file covers each measure on both targets, a cross product made on purpose so that one ruling holds the change. Equal to next on every output: text units left English 22, cells left 350, placeholders not shown once 2, placeholders the content measure cannot place 11, clipped characters 0, the units skipped and why. Units drawn smaller than on next: 36, all the thesis's page growth given back (1.025 to 1.1 to 1.0 to 1.075), none below 1 (270 units below 1 on both). Pixel tier: vanished math 179 to 180, the thesis p66 nu (U+1D708 in the PDF, drawn as U+03BD, the measure's as-text check failing where a crop that moved no longer covers its box; the NFKC fold of mathematical alphanumerics in that check is debt on #299); text translated 1512.03385 zh 64.2 to 63.8 %, 1706.03762 zh 63.9 to 65.1 %, the thesis 51.1 to 50.4 %. Paragraph gaps tighter than the lines beside them (paraGapTight) 250 to 64; under the larger of the two leadings 144 to 23 (a frame of one line above, a paragraph above begun on an earlier page, one whose fit fills its frame at any leading).
why: The maintainer's report, 1512.03385 page 12 in Chinese: each paragraph was filled from its frame's first baseline to its foot at 1.25 to 1.45 pitches, and the next one stood a pitch below it, the gap between paragraphs narrower than the lines inside them (gaps of 11.95 pt between lines 14.9 to 16.7 apart). The drawn gap against the original's (paragraph gap / the original's) read 1.0 there, as it holds the gap to the original's whatever the drawn leading, so its target rewarded the defect; the frame measures (fill, blank lines, frames with a blank line, paragraph gaps wider) read the room the paragraph above now leaves under its last line as blank. B' keeps every paragraph start on the original's baseline, where the line boxes (A) moved 56 % of them by up to a third of a pitch, most with a leading's room over them already, and keeps the original's paragraph skip over the leading (a NeurIPS 5.5 pt parskip, which the leading alone, B, lost). Content, crops and the units drawn are untouched.
